title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, v1.85.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR consolidates auth and retry behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (server/client side) and addresses small parity gaps observed during integration testing. Motivation: teams running mixed-language clients saw inconsistent refresh/retry behavior and awkward streaming APIs which increased boilerplate and caused intermittent production retries. This change: 1) Introduces a common auth adapter pattern implemented per-SDK to unify token refresh, header injection, and failure modes. 2) Centralizes retry policy surface: user-configurable policy object (max_retries, backoff_strategy, retryable_statuses) with consistent defaults and deterministic jitter. 3) Streaming ergonomics: Python and TS now expose a unified async iterator/stream callback pattern; Go exposes a thin wrapper for channel-based streaming to ease parity. 4) Parity fixes and version bumps: align request/response shapes, error code mapping, and bump SDK versions to v1.85.0 for Python/TS/Go. 5) Tests: added integration tests for token refresh under concurrent requests, retry policy behavior under 429/503, and streaming tear-downs. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserved; opt-in config for stricter retry semantics. Rollout notes: staged rollouts for hosted clients and CI gate on downstream integration tests. See changelogs updated in each SDK package.

review_comments: Connor Liu: Please ensure the Python token refresh lock avoids thundering herd on high concurrency. Suggest using an event + cached_future pattern rather than a global lock.
Aisha Patel: Addressed in latest commit a1b2c3d: switched to asyncio.Event + single inflight refresh future pattern and added test coverage.
Priya Srinivasan: Typescript ergonomics look great; can we avoid breaking existing callback-based consumers? Consider compatibility shim.
Aisha Patel: Added a thin compatibility shim that delegates to the new StreamIterator when callback provided; updated docs.
Diego Ramirez: Go wrapper is fine but ensure context cancellation is propagated immediately to server stream handlers.
Aisha Patel: Go stream now cancels context on client Close and we added a test to validate server cancellation.
release_notes: - SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) unified auth adapter and retry config with safer defaults and opt-in strict mode. - Improved streaming ergonomics: unified async iterator for Python/TS and channel wrapper for Go; added compatibility shims. - Parity fixes: aligned error codes and response shapes across SDKs. - Bumped SDK versions to v1.85.0. - Added integration tests for auth refresh and retry behavior.
notes_for_release_engineers: Staged rollout recommended: release SDK packages to registries in order typescript -> python -> go; coordinate with server-side rollout to avoid mixed-client incompatibilities. Monitor 429/503 rates and auth refresh telemetry for first 48h.
